title: Exactness of abelian lower shriek without terminal objects
statement: Fix the small-site universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be continuous and cocontinuous [def-weil-pbc-special-cocontinuous-functor](1). Suppose fibre products and equalizers exist in $\mathcal C$ and are preserved by $u$: their image cones have the corresponding universal properties in $\mathcal D$. An equalizer of $r,s:X\to Y$ means a universal arrow $e:E\to X$ with $re=se$. Write $T^{\mathrm{Ab}}:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ for precomposition on sheaves of abelian groups, and choose a left adjoint $A:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal D)$, meaning natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(AM,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(M,T^{\mathrm{Ab}}N)$. Then $A$ is additive and exact: it carries every short exact sequence $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$ of abelian sheaves to a short exact sequence $0\to AM_1\to AM_2\to AM_3\to0$. No equivalence of localized sites and no terminal object of either site is assumed.

source.place: Tag 04BH, lemma-exactness-lower-shriek, hypotheses (a)-(c) and conclusion; additivity of the left adjoint between abelian categories.

proof.text: Continuity implies that precomposition $T^{\mathrm{Ab}}N(U)=N(uU)$ is a sheaf by [lem-weil-pbc-site-continuous-pushforward-sheaf]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction] with abelian-group coefficients. For a presheaf $F$ put $P(F)(V)=\operatorname{colim}_{J_V}F(U)$, where $J_V=I_V^{\mathrm{op}}$ and $I_V$ has objects $(U,\phi:V\to uU)$ and arrows $r:(U,\phi)\to(U\prime,\phi\prime)$ satisfying $u(r)\phi=\phi\prime$. Then $B(M)=(P(M))^\#$ is left adjoint to $T^{\mathrm{Ab}}$. Each $I_V$ is small: its objects are a union, indexed by the small object set of $\mathcal C$, of hom sets in $\mathcal D$, and its arrows are subsets of the corresponding hom sets of $\mathcal C$.

source.place: Tag 04BH (lemma-exactness-lower-shriek), use of the construction preceding it; the adjunction is Tag 04BG (lemma-g-shriek-adjoint).

proof.text: A common-source span in $J_V$ reverses to $(U\prime,\phi\prime)\xrightarrow{a}(U,\phi)\xleftarrow{b}(U\prime\prime,\phi\prime\prime)$ in $I_V$. Take $Q=U\prime\times_UU\prime\prime$, with projections $p_1,p_2$. Since $u(a)\phi\prime=u(b)\phi\prime\prime$, the image pullback gives a unique $\psi:V\to uQ$ with $u(p_1)\psi=\phi\prime$ and $u(p_2)\psi=\phi\prime\prime$. The projection arrows in $I_V$ satisfy $a p_1=b p_2$. Their opposites complete the given span to a commuting cocone in $J_V$. This is condition (a) of the abelian-colimit lemma.

A parallel pair in $J_V$ reverses to $a,b:(U,\phi)\rightrightarrows(U\prime,\phi\prime)$ in $I_V$. Let $e:E\to U$ be their equalizer in $\mathcal C$. Since $u(a)\phi=u(b)\phi=\phi\prime$ and $u(e)$ is an equalizer, $\phi$ factors uniquely as $u(e)\psi$ for $\psi:V\to uE$. Thus $e:(E,\psi)\to(U,\phi)$ equalizes $a,b$ in $I_V$, and its opposite coequalizes the original pair. This is condition (b). These two checks assert nothing about nonemptiness and apply also when $J_V$ is empty.

By [lem-sfb-almost-filtered-abelian-colimits], the functor $\operatorname{colim}_{J_V}$ is additive and preserves finite limits, including the zero group when $J_V$ is empty. Finite limits of presheaves are objectwise by [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-finite-limits-objectwise]. Consequently $P$ preserves finite limits: evaluate a finite diagram at each $(U,\phi)$ and apply the colimit comparison at each $V$. These comparison maps commute with restriction along $t:V\prime\to V$, since restriction sends $(U,\phi)$ to $(U,\phi t)$ and leaves the element of $F(U)$ unchanged. Additivity of the same colimit functors gives $P(f+g)(V)=P(f)(V)+P(g)(V)$, hence $P$ is additive.

source.place: Tag 04BH (lemma-exactness-lower-shriek), reduction to presheaf colimits and invocation of Algebra Tag 04B0 (lemma-almost-directed-colimit-exact).

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact], inclusion of abelian sheaves preserves limits and abelian sheafification preserves finite limits and all colimits. Thus $B=\#\circ P\circ\iota$ preserves finite limits, in particular kernels. Sheafification is additive: it preserves the zero object and finite biproduct diagrams, so it preserves the diagonal and codiagonal in the identity $f+g=\nabla\circ(f\oplus g)\circ\Delta$. Inclusion is additive because its maps are the same natural transformations with sectionwise addition. Together with step 4 this proves that $B$ is additive.

source.place: Tag 04BH (lemma-exactness-lower-shriek), exactness of abelian sheafification via Tag 03CO (lemma-limits-colimits-abelian-sheaves).

proof.text: The adjunction for $B$ in step 1 and the given adjunction for $A$ provide bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(AM,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}(BM,N)$ natural in $M,N$. The images of the identity maps give maps $BM\to AM$ and $AM\to BM$; naturality shows their two composites are identities and that they commute with every map of $M$. Hence they define a natural isomorphism $A\cong B$. Conjugating a sum of maps by this isomorphism and using step 5 proves additivity of $A$; conjugating the kernel diagrams proves that $A$ preserves kernels.

source.place: Tag 04BH (lemma-exactness-lower-shriek), passage from the constructed left adjoint to any chosen left adjoint, expanded by its universal property.

proof.text: For a short exact sequence $0\to M_1\xrightarrow{i}M_2\xrightarrow{q}M_3\to0$, preservation of its kernel gives $Ai=\ker(Aq)$. To check the cokernel, let $h:AM_2\to N$ satisfy $h\circ Ai=0$. Under the given adjunction, its transpose $\widetilde h:M_2\to T^{\mathrm{Ab}}N$ satisfies $\widetilde h\circ i=0$, by naturality and additivity of $T^{\mathrm{Ab}}$. It factors uniquely through $q$. Transposing back gives the unique factorization of $h$ through $Aq$, so $Aq$ is the cokernel of $Ai$. Thus the image sequence is short exact. No terminal object, local slice equivalence, or assertion about set-valued lower shriek was used.

source.place: Tag 04BH (lemma-exactness-lower-shriek), right exactness of a left adjoint; cokernel universal-property argument written out.
